prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level full-spread widescreen shot from the bed looking toward the bedroom window. A 30-something East Asian Chinese woman has just wrenched the beige blackout curtain open with both hands, the curtain flaring out to the two sides like opened doors. Powerful cold white morning sunlight pours in through the window in a wide blast, lighting up the room and making the dust particles in the air glow like sparks in a light shaft. The woman stands in the center of the window in near-full silhouette against the bright window, both arms raised in a V shape gripping the curtain edges, body weight on the front foot, head tilted slightly back, long straight black hair tied in a low ponytail flying upward from the force, the hem of her fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top billowing from the inrushing air. Her face in silhouette shows wide-open eyes, eyebrows sharply pinched inward, mouth open mid-shout. Through the window behind her the faint cool blue-grey cityscape of neighboring apartment blocks is just visible in early morning haze. Multiple radial speed lines burst from the curtain edges to emphasize the violent opening. Cold blue-grey bedroom interior contrasts with the bright warm-white window. Mood: this is the visual peak of the page and the preview of the book's front cover, the moment the curtain is torn open and everything changes. Text watermark 'P03-PN05' in the bottom-right corner placed where it does not obscure the central light shaft.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, face fully lit and clearly showing soft features, husband visible in bed, decorative window art, daylight already flooding the room (this frame is the moment the light first arrives), second character, romantic soft lighting
